baseline.name: Pre-Crisis Equilibrium
baseline.description: Standard trade flows via Suez Canal. Full Gulf primary smelting and balanced DRAM wafer allocation operational.

moderate_shock.name: Hormuz Transit Alert & Cape Diversion
moderate_shock.description: Commercial shipping begins diverting around Africa; maritime insurance surcharges rise, initial AI wafer crowding emerges.

acute_2026_shock.name: 2026 Acute Middle East Chokepoint Crisis
acute_2026_shock.description: Gulf primary smelters hit; Strait of Hormuz blocked; full Cape detour on Asian/Middle East packaging and global silicon.

ai_datacenter_memory_supercycle.name: AI Supercycle & Memory Squeeze (HBM3e/DRAM Wafer Crunch)
ai_datacenter_memory_supercycle.description: Hyperscaler AI cluster demand consumes 85%+ of SK Hynix, Samsung, and Micron wafer allocation for HBM3e, creating a +72% surge in consumer DRAM/NAND spot prices.
